items.t: Unity Launches The Unity Fellowship to Support Indie Studios
items.sum: SAN FRANCISCO, November 16, 2026--Unity (NYSE: U), the world’s leading game engine, today announced the Unity Fellowship, a new program that invests directly in developers on their road to launch.
